descripcion_geo: Semi-arid region south of Israel, between the Sinai desert and the Dead Sea. Land of patriarchs and caravan route.
importancia_estrategica: Passage area between Egypt and Canaan; land of Abraham, Isaac and the first communities of Israel.

historias.descripcion: Abraham is set between Kadesh and Shur in the Negev; Isaac is born there and Hagar finds water in the desert.

historias.titulo: Israel in the desert of Negev
historias.descripcion: Israel wanders around the Negev and Sinai for forty years as punishment for the spies' disbelief.

historias.titulo: John the Baptist in the Judean Desert
historias.descripcion: John the Baptist preaches in the Judean desert (edges of the Negev): 'Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.'

personajes.descripcion: He lived and camped in the Negev; There he received angelic visits and fathered Isaac.
Only explorer along with Joshua who trusted God when recognizing Negev; received Hebron as inheritance.
He lived and preached in the Judean Desert, on the margins of the Negev.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: The southern desert: place of testing, encounter with God and purification. The patriarchs inhabited it; Israel traveled through it in the exodus; John the Baptist used it as a platform.

mitos.nombre: The desert as a divine meeting place

judaismo.descripcion: The Negev is a land of patriarchs and pilgrimage; In the Bible, the desert is the place where God speaks to the heart (Hos 2:14).
judaismo.significado_teologico: The Negev is a land of patriarchs and pilgrimage; In the Bible, the desert is the place where God speaks to the heart (Hos 2:14).

cristianismo.descripcion: John the Baptist 'prepares the way of the Lord' in the wilderness, fulfilling Isa 40:3.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: John the Baptist 'prepares the way of the Lord' in the wilderness, fulfilling Isa 40:3.

islam.descripcion: Islam venerates Ibrahim (Abraham) who inhabited the region; The desert is a land of prophets.
islam.significado_teologico: Islam venerates Ibrahim (Abraham) who inhabited the region; The desert is a land of prophets.
